name: L-saccharopinate to (R)-crotonylcarnitine
summary: A 6-step route from L-saccharopinate(1−) to (R)-crotonylcarnitine, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: saccharopine dehydrogenase (NADP(+), L-glutamate-forming)
reactions.equation: L-saccharopine + NADP(+) + H2O = (S)-2-amino-6-oxohexanoate + L-glutamate + NADPH + H(+)

reactions.name: glutaryl-CoA dehydrogenase (ETF)
reactions.equation: glutaryl-CoA + oxidized [electron-transfer flavoprotein] + 2 H(+) = (2E)-butenoyl-CoA + reduced [electron-transfer flavoprotein] + CO2

reactions.name: 5-oxoprolinase (ATP-hydrolyzing)
reactions.equation: 5-oxo-L-proline + ATP + 2 H2O = L-glutamate + ADP + phosphate + H(+)

reactions.name: short-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: butanoyl-CoA + oxidized [electron-transfer flavoprotein] + H(+) = (2E)-butenoyl-CoA + reduced [electron-transfer flavoprotein]

reactions.name: holo-[LYS2 peptidyl-carrier protein] + (S)-2-amino-6-oxohexanoate + NADP(+) = L-2-amino...
reactions.equation: holo-[LYS2 peptidyl-carrier protein] + (S)-2-amino-6-oxohexanoate + NADP(+) = L-2-aminoadipyl-[LYS2 peptidyl-carrier protein] + NADPH + H(+)

reactions.name: flavone synthase I
reactions.equation: a flavanone + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = a flavone + succinate + CO2 + H2O

reactions.name: acylcarnitine hydrolase
reactions.equation: an O-acyl-(R)-carnitine + H2O = (R)-carnitine + a fatty acid + H(+)
